title: Fall Foliage & Boone NC Real Estate This October
excerpt: October in the High Country is one of the most stunning times of year — and one of the most underrated windows to make a move in Boone NC real estate. Local REALTOR Andrew Plyler breaks down what fall foliage season means for buyers, sellers, and the mountain property market right now.
